style.promptPrefix: TO BE LOCKED: choose one prefix and seed before generating any frame, then never change them — style consistency across the set depends on it. Suggested register: warm industrial romanticism, soot and brass and ember-orange against cold blue shadow, Victorian foundry scale, glowing metal as the only saturated colour in frame.
style.note: Frames are generated offline and hand-curated (ROADMAP Phase 2). Drop finished PNGs into apps/web/public/art/<slot>.png — BeatArt falls back png → svg → gradient, so partial sets are playable.

slots.brief: A burned-out village smithy at dusk, roof beams collapsed, anvil split. One coal in the ruined bed still glowing — the only warm light in the frame.
A cart road at dawn descending toward a distant city under a permanent brown haze. Chimney stacks on the horizon like a second treeline.
Grey tailings heaps stretching to the horizon. Half-buried armour and cast metal standing upright in the slag, wrong-shaped, facing the viewer.
A vast riveted gate in a coal-black curtain wall, queues of workers funnelling through, guild banners heavy with soot.
A cluttered undercroft workshop lit by a single forge — schematics pinned across every surface, a dwarf artificer's bench in the foreground.
A brick flue tunnel, unlit, heat shimmer distorting the far end. Vent grates in the ceiling glowing faintly orange on a cycle.
Nine stories of concentric brass focusing rings around a central containment throat. Enormous, beautiful, and pointed downward into the city.
A records vault of iron shelving and requisition ledgers, one open on a desk under a shuttered lamp, a signature repeated down the page.
A watch captain in half-armour standing very still in a corridor, holding an open folder, reading something she cannot un-read.
The base of a resonance bell tower at night, seen from the street. Stair windows lit one after another as men climb from the far side.
Inside the bell-frame: a cottage-sized resonance bell, a narrow spiral stair, and armed men coming up through the gap in the boards.
A packed industrial street in full evacuation, all movement flowing away from the viewer, sky above the manufactory district glowing welding-white.
A stone stair descending past three distinct eras of masonry into warm darkness, the deepest stonework older and unlike the rest.
Three ancient stone pylons in a triangle around a suspended point of unbearable light, containment field visible as heat distortion.
The Heart of the Skyforge unshielded — a small, patient, self-illuminating thing, far too bright to look at directly, entirely still.
A cold city at dawn. Every chimney dark for the first time in centuries. Grey light, clear air, an unlit lamp in the foreground.
The Heart back in its pylons, seen from above through the broken throat of the dismantled Array. Guild seals freshly set on the vault door.
A lone figure on a road at dusk, seen from behind, faint light visible through the skin of the hands and forearms. A smith's pack on one shoulder.
